title: JENNIE’s First Solo Trading Card Set Features Autographs & Concert Outfit Cut-Outs: Shop Online Here
summary: Collect all trading cards to find ultra-rare relics.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

JENNIE is officially dealing herself a new hand. The BLACKPINK star is getting her own Topps Chrome trading card collection, marking her first-ever collaboration with the trading card company. The 2026 Topps Chrome x JENNIE collection will be available for preorder on starting today (Aug. 20) at 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m. PT, bringing her solo era to the collector’s market .

Each box contains 10 chrome cards: six base cards, two inserts and two chrome base parallels, with collectors able to chase a rainbow of chrome parallels alongside rare Ruby short prints and super-short prints. The collection also includes cards with JENNIE’s autograph, as well as ultra-rare and autographed relics, which include actual cut-out fabrics from outfits JENNIE has worn on stage.

The base cards feature photoshoot imagery from her solo career, while the broader collection draws directly from her Ruby era, including imagery tied to the album’s visuals.

To help fans track their JENNIE trading card collection, Topps has released a checklist that contains 30 base cards, with 10 chromium close-ups inserts and 10 monochrome mementos inserts alongside two Ruby short prints and one Ruby super-short print card. The base lineup uses photos from JENNIE’s photoshoots, while the inserts offer tighter portraits and monochrome imagery. The Ruby short prints and super-short print feature Ruby artwork.

Topps

The relics are the most direct connection to JENNIE that fans will get from the trading card collection since they contain fragments of clothing worn by JENNIE on stage. That includes The Ruby Experience , the five-show run supporting the solo album that took her to Los Angeles, New York, Incheon and Paris in March 2025.

To get your hands on one of the rarest cards, find the autograph-relic, featuring JENNIE’s signature with concert-worn memorabilia. There is only one variation of the autograph-relic card (as seen below), but there are several autograph card variations, including 10 base autograph cards, two Ruby short-print autograph variations and one Ruby super-short-print autograph variation. See the full checklist here .

For collectors, the odds make clear that the base set is the easiest card to acquire. A base refractor parallel appears roughly once every two packs, while the rarest card, the autograph-relic, is a one-in-150,000 chance of finding. See the full odds list here .

This isn’t JENNIE’s first time partnering with a brand for a Ruby trend. In July, Ray-Ban released ruby-tinted transition glasses modeled by the BLACKPINK singer. However, the Topps collab involves a whole lot of strategy with every purchase.
